subject: Valve cover and the breather hose at its rear, on a 2010 BMW 328i (E90) with the 3.0L inline-6, shown so a home mechanic can see what the step is about. Step: "Prepare for inspection".

mustShow.text: HERO: The plastic cylinder head cover with the integrated crankcase vent and oil separator (one part), with an oil filler cap on top and a row of six ignition coils.
The push-on breather hose connection at the back of the valve cover. Do NOT depict its fine detail: keep it a plain generic shape.
Two side tabs on the hose end that are squeezed to release it; the hose must not be pried.

mustNotShow: valve cover detail (No standalone PCV valve; separate oil separator box; rubber diaphragm or external heated valve: none exist on this design)
oil filler cap detail (Position on the cover is not established)
breather hose release tabs detail (Tab outline and colour are not described)
